title: 供应商准时、完整交付与质量
context: 采购经理比较供应商2025年到期采购行表现。
requirements: 按2025年承诺到期日且非取消采购行；准时足量=截止承诺日接受数量≥订购量；完整=截至年底接受数量≥订购量；质量合格率=接受件数/实际收货件数；输出供应商及分母。
commonError: 有任意一批准时到货并不等于整行准时足量。
executionSteps: 分别计算两种件数履约和质量指标
mysqlSql: SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) due_lines,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) ontime_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN accepted>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) complete_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0),2) quality_pct FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY supplier_id
